desc: The SB Tactical SBA6 is a 5-position adjustable Pistol Stabilizing Brace developed in conjunction with Die Free Co. for firearms capable of accepting a standard mil-spec carbine receiver extension. Designed as the latest evolution of the A-Series adjustable brace lineup, the SBA6 combines a streamlined 1.6-inch profile with a full rubber arm cuff designed to provide a flexible point of contact for stabilization. Compared to the wider SBA3, SBA4, and SBA5, the SBA6 introduces updated dimensions and geometry while maintaining the adjustability and broad platform compatibility of the A-Series. The SBA6 also includes an integral ambidextrous QD sling socket, allowing sling attachment from either side of the brace. An adjustable 1-inch nylon strap is included for a customizable fit.
